Where seamless microcement showers shines in New Orleans homes

  • Walk-in showers where the grout has gone black and won't come clean.
  • Older New Orleans bathrooms with dated but solid tile you'd rather not tear out.
  • Curbless and wet-room style showers that flow straight into the floor.
  • Built-in niches and benches with no grout seams to scrub.
  • Flips and rentals that need a high-end look with no grout upkeep.

Frequently Asked

Answers for New Orleans homeowners.

Will mold grow on microcement?+

Mold in tile showers usually lives in grout lines and failing caulk — porous joints that stay damp. A sealed microcement shower is one continuous surface with no grout lines, so there's no grout for mold to live in. Like any shower, it still needs normal cleaning and ventilation, and the sealer should be maintained as I'll explain at handoff.

How do you waterproof a microcement shower?+

Microcement itself is a thin decorative finish — the waterproofing is a system underneath and on top of it. In plain terms: I inspect what's there (tile, backer board, slope, soft spots) and fix anything failing, prime and reinforce the substrate, install a waterproofing layer through the wet zone and into the corners, niches, and drain, build the microcement base and finish coats, then seal it. Before you sign, I walk you through every layer for your specific bathroom — what I'm keeping, what I'm replacing, and why.

Can microcement go over my existing shower tile?+

Often, yes — after I inspect the tile assembly and confirm it's stable and not hiding water damage. If the tile or what's behind it is failing, I'll show you and we'll rebuild that part properly instead of covering a problem.

How much does a microcement shower cost in New Orleans?+

Every project is priced individually after a site visit. My Essential Seamless Bathroom Overlay starts at $5,500, and most qualifying overlays land between $5,500 and $9,500. Condition of the existing surfaces, size, and plumbing all move the number.

Do I really get free heated floors?+

Yes. Book a whole-bathroom renovation or a whole-floor coating and I buy and install the underfloor heating system at no charge. I'll confirm the details for your floor during the site visit.
